text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Mayano Top Gun and
Oguri Cap
out on the track.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huff... Pant... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That was a great run, Oguri! Here, have
this! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A yakisoba dog? Why are you giving me
this?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's a little "just-because" present!
From me to
you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you take a break after you
eat it. Do
you copy?
choice_data_list: （なんでもない日のプレゼント……？）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh... That was my stomach.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Mayano. Thanks for
this! I'll have
it right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help feeling puzzled by their odd

conversation. While I wonder about it,
my gaze
wanders toward Mayano Top
Gun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is there something you wanna ask?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you mean from earlier? Well, Oguri
looked
upset just now, right?
choice_data_list: “なんでもない日のプレゼント”って？

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I figured something was up with her, but
I didn't
know what exactly...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So I asked around, and that's how I got
to the
bottom of it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aw, that makes sense... I get anxious
when my
times don't improve too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, we all have days where we really
want to try
harder. So I figured it might
be nice to look after
her and make sure
she doesn't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make her feel better, so I
did what my
dad used to do for me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yep! No matter how busy my dad was,
he could
always tell when I was sad.
choice_data_list: さっきのプレゼントなのか？
さっきのプレゼントなんだ？
choice_data_list_en: Is it about the present from earlier?
Is it about the present from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Father
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and open it. You're always
working so
hard, my dear little Maya.

text_block_list.name: Mayano's Father
text_block_list.text:
That's what I call a "just-because"
present.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
He didn't get me anything special or
whatever. It
was usually just snacks or
stationery.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But knowing my dad was always thinking
of me
made me forget all about my
worries!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So that's what inspired me to get
something to
cheer Oguri up!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Besides, doesn't getting someone a
present for no
particular reason kinda
feel like a grown-up thing
to do?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Besides, doesn't getting someone a
present for no
particular reason kinda
feel like a grown-up thing
to do?

text_block_list.text: I know! Isn't he?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I talk to my dad a lot on LANE, and he
even sends
me little "just-because"
presents on there too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Here... Check these out!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
This one's a fancy cafe he saw after
landing! And
this is a pretty view, and
here's a cute kitty pic he
sent me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But you know, it's not the gifts that
make me
happy, it's knowing he's
thinking of me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The grace with which she receives other
people's
kindness leaves quite an
impression on me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wonder where we should go the next
time I get
to see him. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes when he doesn't have any
flights
scheduled, we go out on
father-daughter dates!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We'll go out shopping or visit cafes...
Oh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you could recommend
somewhere
awesome for me and my dad
to go? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
How about a place that's mature and
exciting,
but also cute? And a little
thrilling too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I anguish over Mayano Top Gun's long
list of
conflicting demands.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Aren't I? I'm practically an adult
lady
already! ♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Oh, there she is! ☆ Hey there, Maya! ★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it's Marvey! Hi hi!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We're about to head out to a cafe! ☆
The
rainbow pudding with whipped
cream there is
bound to be marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Is that a new dessert? You're not a
real
adult unless you keep up with the
trends! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching Mayano Top Gun dash off, I
glimpse a
picture-perfect example of
youth in full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly remember what I'm carrying in
my
pocket and tell her that I have
something for her.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But why? I haven't even done
anything.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Are you copying me? ♪ Yay! I
wonder
what it is?
choice_data_list: なんでもない日のプレゼントだよ
choice_data_list_en: It's just a gift for an ordinary day.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a lollipop! I love these! Thank you
so much!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I'm so happy! ♪
